title_zh: 约定先演示拖放文件再发详细指南

scenario.label_zh: 安排软件拖放操作的演示
scenario.goal_zh: 确认屏幕及演示步骤，约定先演示再分发详细指南

context_zh: 同事为一次软件培训安排屏幕和现场演示顺序。
author: author-phase07-b

sentences.speaker: Evan
sentences.text: Could you demonstrate how to move a file into a project folder? The written instructions confused a few people.

sentences.speaker: Sofia
sentences.text: Of course. Can we use the large display in the meeting room? My laptop screen is hard to see from the back.

sentences.speaker: Evan
sentences.text: Yes. Do you need everyone to follow along during the demonstration?

sentences.speaker: Sofia
sentences.text: Not at first. I'd like them to watch me drag the file into the folder, then try with their own practice file.

sentences.speaker: Evan
sentences.text: Should I hand out the detailed guide before you start?

sentences.speaker: Sofia
sentences.text: Afterwards would be better. Otherwise people may read ahead and miss where I click.

sentences.speaker: Evan
sentences.text: All right. I'll set up the display, and we'll leave time for questions after everyone has tried it.

sentences.speaker: Sofia
sentences.text: Thanks. I'll use an empty practice folder so we don't move anyone's real work.

targets.sense_zh: 用鼠标拖动屏幕上的对象
